title: SweetPotatOs Fourth Harvest — Swirl desktop screencast
description:
SweetPotatOs Fourth Harvest (2026.10) — a quick tour of the Swirl desktop on an Arch-based ISO built for older and low-spec PCs.

Download the ISO
https://sourceforge.net/projects/sweetpotatos/files/2026.10_Fourth_Harvest/

Project site / showroom
https://sweetpotatos.sourceforge.io/
https://sweetpotatos.sourceforge.io/showroom.html

Changelog
https://sweetpotatos.sourceforge.io/changelog.html

What you are seeing
• Swirl desktop (SweetPotato) on SweetPotatOs
• Overview (Mod+Tab), tiled windows, status bar, and themes
• Fourth Harvest highlights: Laniakea generative wallpapers, Smart Brightness, quieter logout, floating bar with gaps, new Plymouth logo, and the rolling sweetpotatos-update channel

Stay updated on an installed system
sudo sweetpotatos-update

That refreshes SPO-owned packages (theme, Swirl, Spore, Tuber, Laniakea, …) without a full Arch pacman -Syu. New Harvest ISOs remain for fresh installs.
